quantum-master-functional-amplitude-5d78.title: Quantum Master Mapping (Amplitude)
quantum-master-functional-amplitude-5d78.interpretation: Identifies the transition probability amplitude as a coherent functional integral over all possible field configurations.
quantum-master-functional-amplitude-5d78.symmetry_origin: The variational foundation of quantum phase interference and the subatomic manifold.
quantum-master-functional-amplitude-5d78.limits_and_boundary: Establishes the classical stationary action as the dominant phase contribution in the macroscopic domain.

baryon-photon-ratio-eta-ident-3fd62e75.title: Baryon-Photon Ratio (eta)
baryon-photon-ratio-eta-ident-3fd62e75.interpretation: Quantifies the tiny matter-antimatter asymmetry as the ratio of net baryon density to the photon density in the cosmic microwave background.
baryon-photon-ratio-eta-ident-3fd62e75.symmetry_origin: The residual 'residue' of matter surviving the massive annihilation events of the early Big Bang.
baryon-photon-ratio-eta-ident-3fd62e75.limits_and_boundary: Determines the chemical outcome of Big Bang Nucleosynthesis and the future formation of galaxies.

hall-conductivity-quantization-law-5524f.title: Hall Conductivity Quantization
hall-conductivity-quantization-law-5524f.interpretation: Describes the precise quantization of the transverse Hall conductivity in a two-dimensional electron gas at low temperatures and strong magnetic fields, where nu is an integer (IQHE) or a fraction (FQHE).
hall-conductivity-quantization-law-5524f.symmetry_origin: The topological invariance of the electronic wave functions, specifically the Chern number of the occupied bands.
hall-conductivity-quantization-law-5524f.limits_and_boundary: Independent of material impurities or geometric details, establishing the Hall resistance as a universal standard for metrology.
